summary: Operator camping + hours pages read: 4 back-in RV sites, W/E 20/30/50 A, no sewer (grey-water dump), $50 (undated, footer 2025), showers/flush; booking by email with 50% deposit; separate admission $21.15/person once per stay; grounds closed in winter (stored year_round cleared). Google 4.8/870 (attraction listing). Price exactly at the gate.
flags: PRICE GATE (private, reviewer): posted RV rate $50/night (water + electric; page undated, footer (c) 2025) - at the US$50 line, not over it. No gateway within 40 km. But 'Our admission fee is required if you plan to be on our grounds during our open hours of 9am - 7pm' - $21.15/person (5+), once per stay, not per night; a two-adult one-night stay in the open season is $50 + $42.30. Not a per-night fee, so read as passing; reviewer's call whether the admission counts. Not a Good Sam Park (no discount posted).
GOOGLE: 4.8 stars / 870 reviews - the Ingalls Homestead attraction's listing, shared with the campground (not the campground's alone). Phone 800-776-3594 confirmed; website confirmed.

SEASON: stored year_round true (derived from 'open to take reservations year-round', which is the booking office) contradicted - 'The grounds are closed for the winter'; 2026 open season May 1 - October 31 (grounds; activities to Sept 30). Cleared year_round; the page gives no campground-specific dates. Possible season values opens 05-01 / closes 10-31 if the reviewer accepts the grounds' dates.
